purpose: Measure concrete NumPy short-correlation and FFT alternatives to the production AVX2/FMA folded-anchor coarse grid.

variants.numpy_correlate: np.correlate valid short FIR for every rounded-template symbol/CFO kernel, then vectorized unchanged frame/epoch folding
variants.numpy_fft: one probe FFT plus one symbol-at-a-time bank of 12 kernel FFTs and inverse transforms, then the same folding

science.coefficients: actual rounded complex128 Qin template samples
science.full_candidate_gate_if_promoted: no acquisition candidate identity or scanner decision change on the two frozen application-profile cases

component_timing.thread_environment: all numerical thread variables fixed to one
component_timing.scope: one complete 20 ms receiver coarse grid on seeded random input

promotion_gate.action_on_failure: stop before saved-IQ full application calls and report rejection

bounds.split: component synthetic only unless promotion gate passes
